snippet.title: Lineage II Chronicle 4: Scions of Destiny - CGI Movie
snippet.description:
A female warrior runs tirelessly toward a new world!
An inescapable, undeniable suspicion, however, lurks in a corner of her mind.
Is she merely overwhelmed by all the sights of this new world?
Perhaps it is the uncertainty as to where she should be headed in this wide world that bothers her?

Holding a sword in each hand, she finally asks the real question gnawing at her in desperation. 

Question to whom? The World!

""Tell me, world, how far can I go? Tell me!

You created me. Now, tell me!
What kind of existence must I live? How far can I go?""

The world isn't so  easy to deal with.
The world smiles a leisurely smile, replying with its own questions.

""Oh, yeah? Ha-ha! How far do YOU want to go?""

What the world is saying is that how far you can go (your limits) depends on how far you want to go (your willpower).
